The '''Empire Reborn base''' was a recruiting station on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was headed by a member of the [[Reborn]], a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-imbued soldier. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it was [[Mission to Tatooine (Kyle Katarn)|raided]] by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operative [[Kyle Katarn]] who [[Death/Legends|killed]] all but one of the base's inhabitants.
